{{Quote|Pillon Miner, he's human&mdash;he was the first one to find out that the amphistaff polyps in that grove over there are mature enough to attack. Peritonitis. He's dying.|Jacen Solo, speaking about Miner|<ref name="Traitor" />}}
'''Pillon Miner''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. He was captured by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] that had invaded [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and was [[Slavery/Legends|forced to work]] on a [[Unidentified seedship|Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Sh'rip Sh'pa|seedship]], a type of [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]].<ref name="Traitor" /> In [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Miner was grievously injured when he mistakenly walked into a grove of maturing [[amphistaff]]s, organic Yuuzhan Vong weapons. Fellow slave and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] tried to help Miner, who was dying from [[peritonitis]], but was unable to do so.<ref name="Traitor" /><ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|316|Miner, Pillon}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Miner was first mentioned in the [[2002]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]'', which is part of the [[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order|''The New Jedi Order'']] series. ''Traitor'' was written by [[Matthew Stover]].<ref name="Traitor" />
